svg.aria-label: Fleshed-out CFC pipeline flowchart. Three nested containers: RunCohort loops over session folders, RunSession loops over CSC files, and RunChannel is the only code that touches signal. Inside RunChannel: a CSC ncs file goes to LoadCSC, then FindIEDs, then MakeEpochs, which branches into CFC.m and ThetaPower.m. Those produce a comodulogram array of slow by fast by epoch and a theta power array of theta by epoch, which both feed ChannelQC and SaveChannel. Session and cohort levels each add their own QC figure. Below, a Python results layer runs collect, then attach where metadata is joined, then three output figures and a statistics step.
